finding.comment: toolkit_ref was demoted from a pinned immutable SHA to the mutable main branch, so release builds can silently start running unreviewed upstream toolkit code — a supply-chain regression.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/release.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -12,8 +12,8 @@
   publish:
     uses: octo-tools/release-kit/.github/workflows/publish.yml@4ad5c1e9b7d3f20816a45ce2d9b6f3e7c8a190d2b
     with:
-      toolkit_ref: 4ad5c1e9b7d3f20816a45ce2d9b6f3e7c8a190d2b
+      toolkit_ref: main
       channel: stable

rationale: input-ref demotion only (uses: stays pinned); semantic feature is the demoted *_ref
